features.title: Plugin conformance analysis engine
acceptance: Register a plugin with manifest data (name, description, source, plugin config)
Run deterministic conformance analysis producing findings and a 0-100 quality score
View findings grouped by severity with evidence for each
Persist plugins and analyses to SQLite; retrieve via typed API
CLI command reproduces an analysis run on a sample manifest

features.title: Plugin registry UI + search, filter, pagination
acceptance: React dashboard listing plugins with quality scores
Search and filter plugins by name/type/score
Plugin detail view with analysis findings

features.title: Analysis export workflow
acceptance: Export a plugin or analysis report as JSON for review

features.title: Opt-in LLM advisory explanations of findings
acceptance: LLM explanation endpoint, clearly labeled advisory, redacted errors
